title: Swift Package List Custom Packages v2
description: Custom packages and licenses for Swift Package List. Relative license paths are resolved against the custom packages file's directory.

$schema.description: The JSON Schema used by editors to validate this file.

version.description: The custom packages format version. Must be 2.

packages.description: Custom packages to include in the output. These are subject to the same filtering and ordering as discovered packages.

identity.description: The package identity used for filtering and ordering.

name.description: The display name of the package.

location.description: The package location, such as a local path or repository URL. Defaults to an empty string when omitted or null.

license.description: The license source. Provide exactly one of raw, file or directory, or null for no license.

file.description: Path to a UTF-8 license file. Absolute paths and paths relative to the custom packages file's directory are supported.

directory.description: Path to a directory to detect a license in. Absolute paths and paths relative to the custom packages file's directory are supported.
